whatIsLeft: Almost all of the remainder is not translatable text. It is the stored values of the settings choice rows - listOf("Auto", "Media3", "MPV") and its like - which are persisted and synced to the account, so they must stay exactly as they are; what the viewer reads for each one comes from settingsOptionLabel and is localised. The rest is product and service names: StreamDek, SyncDek, Trakt, MDBList, IMDb, IntroDB, PunchPlay. The detector counts every literal inside those builders on purpose, so a genuinely new English label cannot hide among them - which means this number will not reach zero, and should not be pushed there by silencing the check.
